delivery.outcome: Decompose prepare_workspace in src/koru/ticket_command/workspace.py: extract the main-only delivery return into _main_only_workspace, the governed-delivery precondition gate (checker pin, feature probe, intent template) into _pinned_checker_args, the managed allocation into _allocate_ticket, the plan/validate cycle into _planned_layout, the lease creation into _write_lease, the worktree materialization into _materialize_worktree and the ticket record seeding into _seed_ticket_records, dropping the orchestrator from CC=10 / fan-out=23 / mutations=17 to CC=2 / fan-out=9 / mutations=6 (god-function thresholds: fan-out > 10, mutations > 6, CC > 12) while preserving the exact check order, error messages, lease bytes, worktree layout and the public prepare_workspace/preflight_workspace contract used by service.py and the ticket-command tests.
nonGoals: Changing the delivery flow semantics, error strings or the order of preflight checks
Refactoring preflight_workspace, service.py or other modules of the ticket_command package
Altering the koru ticket GitHub-issue execution behavior

architecture.decision: Split the governed-delivery body of prepare_workspace into single-responsibility module-level helpers (_main_only_workspace, _pinned_checker_args, _allocate_ticket, _planned_layout, _write_lease, _materialize_worktree, _seed_ticket_records) that stay in workspace.py so the ticket-command tests keep patching module.command and module.git, and return values instead of unpacking tuples at call sites so code2llm does not double-count mutations.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single inline prepare_workspace body.

validation.evidence: prepare_workspace is CC 2 with fan-out 9 and 6 mutations; every extracted helper is at or below every god-function threshold (fan-out > 10, mutations > 6, CC > 12).
The real prepare_workspace integration test and the dirty-main refusal test pass unchanged; no error strings, check order or lease bytes changed.
